title: Izilimi zivelaphi?
invitation: Yazi isihlahla somndeni esingemuva kwazo zonke izilimi zokufunda eziyi-104 ze-Gef, kanye nezingxenye zomlando wolimi ezingangeni kahle esihlahleni esisodwa kuphela.
summary: Izilimi zifa amaphethini ezilimini ezindala, ziboleka komakhelwane, zihamba nabantu, futhi ziguquke lapho imiphakathi yakha izinhlobo namazinga amasha. Lesi sifundo sibeka zonke izilimi eziyi-104 ze-Gef emephini ngaphandle kokudidanisa uzalo, indawo, uhlelo lokubhala nezombusazwe.

atlas_labels.title: I-atlas yemindeni yezilimi ye-Gef
atlas_labels.description: Ubunikazi bolimi lokufunda ngalunye olukhona manje buvela kanye kuphela. Izinhlobo zombhalo, izifunda, ukuguqulwa kwezinhlamvu noma usizo lokufunda akwakhi ulimi olusha. Izilimi zokuthintana ziboniswa ngokwehlukana ngoba igatsha lomzali elilodwa alikwazi ukuchaza kahle ukuthi zakheka kanjani.
atlas_labels.accessibility_label: I-atlas yemindeni yezilimi enazo zonke izilimi zokufunda eziyi-104 ze-Gef

notes.atlantic_congo: Ilebula ebanzi esetshenziswa ngokucophelela ezilimini ze-Gef eziboniswa lapha. Niger-Congo nayo yigama elivamile; ukuhlukaniswa kwangaphakathi ezingeni eliphezulu akulingani ngokuqiniseka kuyo yonke indawo.
notes.basque: I-Basque ibhekwa njengolimi oluzimele ngoba indlela yokuqhathanisa ayikafakazeli umndeni wozalo obanzi kunalokho.

atlas_labels.contact_note: Ziqoqwa ngomlando wokwakheka kwazo kunokuphoqwa ngaphansi kwegatsha lomzali elilodwa. Ukukhula kwazo kukhombisa ukuthintana okunamandla kwezilimi eziningi kanye nobuciko bomphakathi.

blocks.title: Lonke ulimi lunokhokho
blocks.text: Izilimi aziqanjwa ngesikhathi esisodwa. Izingane zifunda ukukhuluma kwabanye; isizukulwane ngasinye siguqula imisindo nohlelo lolimi kancane; imiphakathi iyahamba futhi ihlangane; namagama ahamba nabantu. Ezinkulungwaneni zeminyaka, uhlobo olulodwa oludala lungahlukana lube izilimi ezintsha eziningi. Ezinye ziyizihlobo eziseduze, ezinye zikude, kanti ezinye zingomakhelwane kuphela. I-Gef manje inezilimi zokufunda eziyi-104; lesi sifundo siyimephu engemuva kwaleyo mephu.

blocks.title: Umndeni wolimi umayelana nefa
blocks.text: Izazi zezilimi zomlando ziqhathanisa ukufana kwemisindo okujwayelekile, amagama ayisisekelo, ukwakheka kwamagama namaphethini ohlelo lolimi ukuze zihlole ifa elivela kukhokho oyedwa. Igama elilodwa elifanayo alanele ngoba izilimi ziboleka njalo komunye nomunye. Ngakho isiNgisi siyi-Germanic, isiPheresiya siyi-Indo-European, isi-Arabhu siyi-Afro-Asiatic, kanti isiVietnam siyi-Austroasiatic. Umndeni usho umsuka, hhayi izwe, uhlanga, izinhlamvu noma udumo.

blocks.title: I-atlas yemindeni yezilimi ye-Gef
blocks.description: Bonke ubunikazi bezilimi zokufunda eziyi-104 ezikhona manje buvela kanye kuphela.

blocks.title: Indo-European: umndeni omkhulu onqamula amazwekazi
blocks.text: Ngaphezu kwengxenye yezilimi zokufunda ze-Gef zamanje ziyi-Indo-European. Amagatsha e-Germanic, Romance, Slavic, Baltic kanye ne-Celtic asakazeke eYurophu; amagatsha e-Indo-Aryan nase-Iranian afinyelela eNingizimu naseNingizimu-Ntshonalanga ye-Asia. IsiGreki simele i-Hellenic; isi-Armenian nesi-Albanian sinamagatsha aso amakhulu. IsiHindi nesiNgisi ziyizihlobo zozalo ezikude; isi-Arabhu nesiPheresiya akunjalo.

blocks.title: EMpumalanga naseNingizimu-Mpumalanga ye-Asia: omakhelwane akusho ukuthi bayizihlobo
blocks.text: I-Mandarin Chinese ne-Cantonese yizilimi ze-Sinitic emndenini we-Sino-Tibetan; isiBurmese sikwelinye igatsha lomndeni ofanayo obanzi. IsiJapanese siyi-Japonic, isiKorean siyi-Koreanic. Umbhalo namagama esiShayina kube nomthelela omkhulu kuzo zombili, kodwa umthelela awushintshi uzalo. IsiVietnam nesiKhmer ziyi-Austroasiatic; isiThai, isiLao nesiShan yizilimi ze-Tai ngaphakathi kwe-Kra-Dai. Isihlahla somndeni sibonisa umsuka; imephu yokuthintana ibonisa ukusebenzisana.

blocks.title: ENtshonalanga nase-Asia Ephakathi: izihlahla eziningana eziphothene
blocks.text: Izilimi ze-Turkic ze-Gef yi-Turkish, Azerbaijani, Bashkir, Chuvash, Kazakh, Kyrgyz, Turkmen ne-Uzbek. IsiMongolian siyi-Mongolic, hhayi i-Turkic. Umbono omdala wokuhlanganisa imindeni ye-Turkic ne-Mongolic njengomndeni owodwa we-“Altaic” usaphikiswa; i-Gef ayiwufundisi njengozalo oluqinisekisiwe. Isi-Estonian, isi-Finnish nesi-Hungarian ziyi-Uralic. ECaucasus, isiGeorgian siyi-Kartvelian, isi-Armenian siyi-Indo-European, isi-Azerbaijani siyi-Turkic.

blocks.title: EAfrika naseMpumalanga Ephakathi: ukuhlukahluka okujulile ngemuva kwamagama ajwayelekile
blocks.text: Ngaphakathi kwe-Afro-Asiatic, isi-Arabhu, isiHebheru, isi-Amharic nesi-Tigrinya ziyi-Semitic; isiHausa siyi-Chadic; isiSomali nesi-Oromo ziyi-Cushitic. I-Gef ibonisa isiSwahili, isi-Akan, isi-Igbo, isi-Yoruba nesiZulu ngaphansi kohlaka olubanzi lwe-Atlantic-Congo ngokucophelela ekuhlukaniseni kwezinga eliphezulu. IAfrika inemindeni yezilimi nezilimi ezizimele eziningi kakhulu kunalezo i-Gef ezimele manje.

blocks.title: Austronesian: izihlobo ezisakazeke emhlabeni wolwandle
blocks.text: Isi-Indonesian, isiMalay, isiJavanese, isiFilipino nesiHawaiian ziyi-Austronesian. Ukuhamba olwandle, ukufuduka, ukuhweba, umshado, ukuhlala, izikole kanye nenqubomgomo yombuso kusiza ukuchaza lapho zikhulunywa khona namuhla. Ubunikazi bolimi kumkhiqizo abufani negatsha elijulile esihlahleni somndeni: isi-Indonesian nesiMalay ziyizihlobo ezijwayelekile ezisondele kakhulu; isiHawaiian sikude kakhulu emndenini omkhulu ofanayo.

blocks.title: INingizimu ye-Asia inomndeni omkhulu ongaphezu kowodwa
blocks.text: Izilimi eziningi ze-Gef enyakatho yeNingizimu ye-Asia ziyi-Indo-Aryan, ngakho ziyi-Indo-European. IsiTamil, isiTelugu, isiMalayalam nesiKannada zisemndenini ohlukile we-Dravidian. Amakhulu eminyaka okuthintana adale amagama abolekiwe nezici zesifunda ezabiwe ngaphandle kokususa imisuka ehlukene. “Ulimi lwaseNdiya” luchaza indawo noma umongo kazwelonke, hhayi umndeni wolimi owodwa.

blocks.title: Imindeni emincane nolimi oluzimele nayo inomlando ophelele
blocks.text: IsiQuechua siyi-Quechuan, isiGeorgian siyi-Kartvelian, isiMongolian siyi-Mongolic, isiJapanese siyi-Japonic, isiKorean siyi-Koreanic. Ukuthi i-Gef inolimi olulodwa kuphela oluvela emndenini othile akuwenzi lowo mndeni ungabaluleki. I-Basque ibhekwa njengolimi oluzimele ngoba umndeni omkhulu kunawo awukafakazelwa ngokwanele. Ulimi oluzimele alusho ulimi oludala noma olungathuthukile.

blocks.title: Eminye imlando iboniswa kangcono njengenethiwekhi
blocks.text: I-Nigerian Pidgin ne-Haitian Creole zakheka ekuthintaneni okunamandla kwezilimi eziningi. IsiNgisi singumthombo omkhulu womlando wamagama e-Nigerian Pidgin, isiFulentshi se-Haitian Creole, kodwa zombili zibuye zibonise izakhiwo, ubunikazi, izinto ezintsha nezinye izilimi zemiphakathi eyazidala. Ngakho i-Gef izibonisa ngaphansi komlando wokuthintana, hhayi ngaphansi kwegatsha lomzali elilodwa eliphoqelelwe.

blocks.title: Umbhalo ungakhohlisa iso
blocks.text: Izinhlelo zokubhala ziyitheknoloji; imindeni yezilimi iwuzalo. Izilimi ezingezona izihlobo zingasebenzisa umbhalo ofanayo, kanti izilimi eziyizihlobo zingasebenzisa imibhalo ehlukene. Isi-Arabhu, isiPheresiya, isi-Urdu ne-Sorani Kurdish zisebenzisa imibhalo ehlobene esekelwe esi-Arabhu, kodwa isi-Arabhu siyi-Afro-Asiatic, ezinye ziyi-Indo-European. IsiSerbian singabhalwa nge-Cyrillic noma nge-Latin. Ku-Gef, izinhlobo zombhalo, transliteration nosizo lokufunda akwandisi inani elingu-104.

blocks.title: Kungani izilimi zihamba, zehlukane, zixubane futhi ziboleke?
blocks.text: Ukuhweba, imibuso, izinkolo, ukufuduka, amadolobha, izikole, imidiya nohulumeni kushintsha indawo yezilimi. Ukusabalala kolimi akuhlali kunokuthula: ukususwa ngenkani, ubugqila, ukunqoba, ubukoloni, izinqubomgomo zokumuncwa kanye nemizabalazo yemiphakathi yokugcina noma ukuvuselela izilimi zayo nakho kuyingxenye yomlando. Kunabantu ngemuva kwawo wonke umugqa emephini.

blocks.title: Ulimi olulodwa luphela kuphi, olunye luqala kuphi?
blocks.text: Uzalo luchaza ukuhlobana komlando, kodwa alunqumi lodwa amagama ezilimi zesimanje. Izincwadi, imfundo, izikhungo, ubunikazi bobuzwe, ezombusazwe, amazinga okubhala kanye nendlela izikhulumi ezizibona ngayo konke kubalulekile. IsiBosnian, isiCroatian nesiSerbian yizindinganiso ze-South Slavic ezisondele kakhulu kodwa ziyizimpawu zesimanje ezihlukene ku-Gef. I-Bokmål ne-Nynorsk yizindinganiso ezimbili zokubhala zesiNorwegian. IsiHindi nesi-Urdu zabelana ngesisekelo solimi esisondele kakhulu, kodwa umbhalo, irejista ejwayelekile nomlando wamasiko kungahluka.

blocks.title: Sazi kanjani ngokhokho abangakaze baqoshwe?
blocks.text: Izazi zezilimi zomlando zisebenzisa indlela yokuqhathanisa. Ziqhathanisa izilimi, zithole ukufana kwemisindo okujwayelekile nezinto zohlelo lolimi ezabiwe, bese zakha kabusha izici ezichaza kahle izilimi eziyinzalo. Ukufana kwegama elilodwa okumangalisayo kuwubufakazi obubuthaka; iphethini ephindaphindayo emagameni ayisisekelo nasezakhiweni eziningi inamandla. Ukhokho owakhiwe kabusha ubizwa nge-proto-language. I-Proto-Indo-European iwukwakhiwa kabusha kwesayensi, hhayi ukuqoshwa komsindo. Lapho sibuyela kude esikhathini esidlule, ukungaqiniseki kuyanda.

blocks.title: Isihlahla siwumlando, hhayi izinga
blocks.description: Manje usunemephu engemuva kwemephu: izilimi eziyi-104, imindeni eminingi kanye nemilando yokuthintana kwesinye isikhathi echazwa kangcono yinethiwekhi kunesihlahla. Ukuhlobana akusho ukuthi ulimi lungcono, luhlanzekile, lulula noma lubaluleke kakhulu. Uma izilimi ezimbili zifana, buza: ifa elihlanganyelwe noma ukuthintana komlando?
